glosses: Asturian (native or inhabitant of Asturias, Spain) (usually male)
Of, from or relating to Asturias, Spain.

examples.text: This gave time to many families to escape; and Bermudo even carried away the bodies of his predecessors to the old refuge in the Asturian hills.

glosses: Of or pertaining to the Asturian language.

examples.text: The winning entry was a poem written in Asturian, one of the first such in Asturian literature.

glosses: A native or inhabitant of Asturias, Spain.

examples.text: To this day the Asturians say to each other "Have a care. Asturias is Spain. The rest is Araby."

glosses: A Romance language spoken in Asturias, Spain.

examples.text: The winning entry was a poem written in Asturian, one of the first such in Asturian literature.
In Asturias/Asturies 18.3% of the respondents said they spoke Asturian always or most of the time with friends[…]
